'''Dail'Liss''' was a [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Librarian/Legends|librarian]] of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]]. He spoke with a strange accent, in which he pronounced "yes" as "jess," and he served as caretaker of the [[Odacer-Faustin academy library|academy library]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Darth Drear]]. He was the only person that knew about the research of [[Darth Scabrous]], due to his knowledge of [[Darth Drear's holocron]]. Dail'Liss survived for a long time while the infection known as the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Sickness]] ravaged throughout the academy, staying secure in the library. However, the Neti was eventually infected by Scabrous himself.<ref name="Harvest" />

Darth Scabrous used Dail'Liss to lure [[Hestizo Trace]] into the library by mimicking the voice of the [[Murakami orchid]], still alive amidst the Sickness. The plan worked and Hestizo was captured by Scabrous. Meanwhile, Dail'Liss began to succumb to the Sickness, and in his maddened state, he started burning all of the library's scrolls and [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]]. He was found by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rojo Trace]], Hestizo's brother. After being captured by the Neti and seeing his memories of his discovery of the Sith Temple beneath the library, Trace escaped and went after his sister.<ref name="Harvest" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dail'Liss appeared in the [[2011]] novel [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']], written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Harvest" /> His name translated in the [[Neti (language)|Neti]] as "lover of knowledge."
